title: Payment gateway
goal: Show a gateway selecting provider implementations through an interface.

rubric.must: PaymentProvider is visibly marked as an interface.
CardProvider and WalletProvider each use dashed hollow-triangle realization arrows pointing to PaymentProvider.
Payment has a filled composition diamond to PaymentRequest.
PaymentStatus is visibly an enumeration-like classifier listing PENDING, AUTHORIZED, and DECLINED.
PaymentService has a dashed dependency arrow to PaymentRequest.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the umlclass exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: All required elements are visible and legible: the interface, both realization arrows, composition, enumeration, and dashed dependency. Connections and labels are traceable, with no material overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: CardProvider and WalletProvider each connect to PaymentProvider with a dashed line and hollow triangle pointing to the interface.
Payment connects to PaymentRequest with a filled diamond at the Payment end and multiplicity 1 at both ends.
PaymentStatus is marked «enumeration» and lists PENDING, AUTHORIZED, and DECLINED.
PaymentService has a dashed dependency arrow labeled “uses” pointing to PaymentRequest.
